description: List the connected team's screens: online status and what each screen and sub-screen shows right now (its normal content, pushed content, a scene or screen mirroring), with the end time if there is one. Also returns the account's time zone and current local time. Filter with query (part of a screen or sub-screen name) or screen_id. Results come in pages: pass next_cursor as cursor for the next page.

query.description: Part of a screen or sub-screen name.

name: list_screens
title: List screens
